1. (Currently Amended) A method, comprising: applying a first coating material on a threaded region of an opening in a multi-piece assembly; inserting at least one fastener to the threaded region, the fastener including a mating thread selectively secured to the threaded region of the opening to create a first friction interface between the fastener and the multi-piece assembly; and tensioning the fastener between a load surface of the multi-piece assembly and a mating thread of the fastener to define a second friction interface between the multi-piece assembly and the fastener, the second friction interface being spaced away from the threaded region such that the first coating material does not influence the second friction interface, __wherein the first coating material is applied in a thickness of less than 0.005 inches__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising establishing the first coating material as being applied solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads, __wherein the uniform thickness is maintained to within ±0.001 inches along the threaded region__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising adjusting the first friction interface independent of the second friction interface, __by controlling the application of the first coating material to the threaded region prior to insertion of the fastener__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3, wherein adjusting the first friction interface includes adjusting an amount of the first coating material applied to the threaded region, thereby increasing friction at the first friction interface without affecting friction at the second friction interface, __wherein the amount is adjusted by varying the application duration or application pressure of the coating material__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein applying the first coating material includes filling the opening at least partially with a coating fluid, __wherein the coating fluid is applied to a depth of at least 50% of the threaded region depth__.

9. (Original) The method of claim 1, further comprising providing a second coating material at the second friction interface.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the second coating material includes a corrosion-resistant coating.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive, __wherein the thread locking adhesive has a shear strength of at least 1000 psi__.

12. (Currently Amended) A method, comprising: applying a first coating material on a threaded region of an opening in a first multi-piece assembly included in plurality of multi-piece assemblies; inserting at least one fastener to the threaded region, the fastener including a mating thread selectively secured to the threaded region of the [[aperture]] __opening__ to create a first friction interface between the fastener and the first multi-piece assembly, the fastener having a second coating material; tensioning the fastener between a load surface of the multi-piece assembly and a mating thread of the fastener to define a second friction interface between the multi-piece assembly and the fastener, the second friction interface being spaced away from the threaded region such that the first coating material does not influence the second friction interface; adjusting an amount of the first coating material applied to the threaded region in a subsequent multi-piece assembly, thereby increasing friction at the first friction interface of the subsequent multi-piece assembly compared with the first multi-piece assembly, the friction at the second friction interfaces of the first multi-piece assembly and the subsequent multi-piece assembly being substantially equal, __wherein the first coating material thickness in the subsequent multi-piece assembly is at least 25% greater than in the first multi-piece assembly__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising: establishing the multi-piece assemblies as connecting rods; wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive and the second coating material includes a corrosion-resistant coating, __wherein the thread locking adhesive is applied prior to fastener insertion and the corrosion-resistant coating is applied to fastener surfaces that contact the load surface__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising establishing the first coating material as being applied solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads, __wherein the uniform thickness is maintained to within ±0.001 inches along the threaded region__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, wherein applying the first coating material includes filling the opening at least partially with a coating fluid, __wherein the coating fluid is applied to a depth of at least 50% of the threaded region depth__.
